[[Bartholos' Shining Blade]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]]. As the name would suggest, this sword is a replica of the one [[Bartholos]] wields.

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage|Slashing Dmg]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:Damage +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Double [[adrenaline]] gain (Chance: 10%)
:Swordsmanship +1 (Chance: 20% while using [[skill]]s) 

==Skin==
Has the same skin as a [[Gothic Sword]] and [[Legendary Sword]].
